veranderings.voor: Baie van hierdie druppeltjies saam vorm
veranderings.na: Baie van hierdie druppeltjies vorm saam
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans the adverb 'saam' follows the finite verb; 'druppeltjies saam vorm' is unnatural word order.

veranderings.voor: meestal as reën, en as sneeu
veranderings.na: meestal as reën en as sneeu
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence; the second half has no subject and verb of its own.
'Nog water' reads as 'even more water'; 'Ander water' says clearly that this is a different part of the rain, matching 'Baie ander water' later in the lesson.

veranderings.voor: iets wat oor en oor herhaal
veranderings.na: iets wat oor en oor gebeur
veranderings.rede: 'Herhaal' is transitive in Afrikaans and needs an object or 'hom'; 'gebeur' keeps the meaning without adding a word.
